description:
About our brand and products:Earthedin specializes in premium grounding (earthing) wellness bedding designed to help people reconnect with the Earth's natural energy for better sleep and recovery. Our product line includes high-quality grounding flat sheets, pillowcases, and mats, all meticulously crafted using advanced, highly conductive silver fibers to ensure maximum efficacy.

What makes us different:We prioritize verifiable quality and customer trust. Unlike many competitors, our products are built to meet rigorous textile testing standards. A key differentiator is our "double testing" verification approach—we include free conductivity testers in our trial kits, empowering customers to physically verify the grounding effect in their own homes and building immediate trust in the product.

How affiliates can earn:Affiliates can earn highly competitive commissions on every qualifying purchase made through their unique tracking links. Because our premium grounding bedding sets have a strong Average Order Value (AOV), your earning potential per conversion is substantial.

How to promote us:Authentic, educational content works best for our niche. We highly encourage our partners to create in-depth review articles, sleep-quality journey vlogs, and especially video demonstrations showing the product's conductivity using a multimeter or our included tester pen. You can share your links across YouTube, wellness blogs, Instagram, TikTok, or dedicated email newsletters.

Other information:We are committed to our affiliates' success and provide access to high-converting landing pages and professional marketing assets. We look forward to partnering with creators who are passionate about holistic health, biohacking, and improving everyday wellness.
payout_period: Payouts are processed on the 1st of every month for all approved conversions. Please note there is a 20-day clearing period for new sales to account for order cancellations. Minimum payout: $50.
